Third VERDANT governance committee to approve the pilot's final policy for synthetic data, aggregated hourly data, local processing of 15-minute data, export and auditing.

Andrés Beltrán: We have completed the three planned tests. Today we must approve a stable policy for the remainder of the pilot.
Sergio Vidal: The hourly transfer and local processing produced complete provenance and audit records.
Nuria Castaño: The connector automatically enforces resolution, minimum group size, retention, decision signatures and rejection of prohibited requests.
Héctor Molina: I propose consolidating four levels. First, synthetic data with automatic access for testing. Second, aggregated hourly data exportable with provider and purpose approval. Third, 15-minute data processable only within the provider under enhanced controls. Fourth, raw 15-minute series not exportable during the pilot.
Carmen Rey: SolCentro accepts that classification. Local processing must retain prior code review and subsequent output approval.
Bruno Silva: The receiving partner needs to verify the signature and effective group size, but does not need access to the original data.
Inés Ferrer: May aggregated results be reused in another analysis?
Javier Ortega: Only if the purpose is included in the original decision or an extension is submitted. There will be no automatic reuse.
Andrés Beltrán: We also add deletion after ninety days for hourly data, immediate revocation by the provider and audit retention for five years.
Héctor Molina: Under those conditions, the privacy assessment is closed for the current scope.
Andrés Beltrán: VERDANT policy v1.0 is approved. Export of raw 15-minute data remains prohibited; local processing and aggregated hourly data are the authorized routes.
